import sys, json, re, hashlib, unicodedata
from collections import Counter

# entity-glue (GH #1057, owner ruling 2026-10-07, option A): the producer of
# `entities` and `entity_edges`. Since the extractor went (#298) nothing wrote
# either table, and the graph leg of recall (#520) walked an empty graph on
# every hive grown since: measured on a 6-month synthetic history, 877 facts,
# 26 subject aliases, 0 entities, 0 edges, and half of the two-hop questions
# answered wrong because the second hop never reached the bundle.
#
# Deterministic and model-free, incremental everywhere (review of 2026-10-07:
# the first cut read every fact of every touched subject on each write --
# the member is touched by nearly every write -- and derived the whole graph
# in one night bundle: 10k facts x 500 entities = 15-20k ops in ONE message
# against a 15 s cell timeout, so a hive three times that size would never
# consolidate again, silently):
#   * `entity-new` -- after EVERY fact write the ingress hands this cell the
#     ids it just wrote. The cell works on THOSE facts only: a subject that
#     is no entity yet is counted (an entity is never re-counted, a hub's
#     facts are never read), and every edge the new facts evidence is read by
#     its deterministic id and written only when it gains evidence. It never
#     removes and never reopens what the night closed.
#   * `entity-night` -- at the end of every dream run, inside the dream lane,
#     the delta since the last run: facts recorded since, facts closed since
#     (forget, retract), alias rows that merged two subjects, and the facts
#     that mention an entity born since. Each of those facts is derived again
#     and its evidence brought to exactly that, so a night after a day of
#     producer ticks and a night alone end in the same rows. Writes go out in
#     bundles of at most WRITE_OPS ops; after each the step is derived again
#     until nothing is left to write. Until the night has once finished a
#     paged backfill over every stored fact -- recorded in its own `scratch`
#     row (STATE_KEY), never read off the entity rows -- it runs that
#     backfill instead, resumable across nights, and derives the delta of the
#     whole backfill span after it.
#
# Resolution goes ONLY through `subject_aliases` (never by similarity): two
# unlinked spellings stay two entities until an alias row links them, and a
# claim mentions an entity only by one of those spellings, as whole words.

if not globals().get("_ENTITY_LIB_ONLY"):
    doc = json.load(sys.stdin)
    d = doc["body"]
    P = doc.get("params") or {}
    envelope = doc["envelope"]
    h = envelope.get("header", {})
    ctx = h.get("context", {})
    hop = h.get("hop", {})
    phase = str(ctx.get("mem_phase", ""))
    op = hop.get("operation")
    err = str(hop.get("error_code", "") or "")
    clock = str(ctx.get("ent_clock", "") or "")
else:
    P = globals().get("P") or {}


def _int(key, default):
    v = P.get(key, default)
    if v is None or (isinstance(v, str) and not v.strip()):
        return default
    return int(v)


# A subject is a candidate with at least MIN_FACTS facts from at least
# MIN_EPISODES episodes (ruling), or when it is a speaker reference.
MIN_FACTS = _int("min_facts", 2)
MIN_EPISODES = _int("min_episodes", 2)
# An entity with more distinct neighbours than this is a HUB: the member
# itself, measured at 25 neighbours on the 6-month history where every other
# person had 1-4. Edges INTO a hub carry `edge_kind` `co-hub`, and recall's
# walk does not enter them -- a hub anchor is true of every question (#536).
HUB_DEGREE = _int("hub_degree", 12)
# Review 2026-10-07 (finding 6): one night bundle held 15-20k ops. A write
# bundle now carries at most this many; the step is derived again after it.
WRITE_OPS = 500
# Rows one count read may return: a subject that is no entity yet has few
# facts (it becomes one at MIN_FACTS), so a full page means "enough".
COUNT_PAGE = _int("count_page", 500)
# Facts one newborn's mention search may return. Review N7 (kf89 deep
# review): a full page is said on stderr -- the mentions beyond it get no
# edge from this night -- instead of being cut without a word.
NEWBORN_HITS = _int("newborn_hits", 200)
# Backfill pages: subjects by canonical key, then facts by id. The delta
# night pages its window by the same fact page (review N6).
BACKFILL_SUBJECTS = 1000
BACKFILL_FACTS = 200
# A step that still has writes after this many rounds gives up loudly
# (a refused write would otherwise loop forever).
MAX_ROUNDS = 8
# The round edge `./entity-glue -> ./entity-glue` passes a step only while
# `hop.ent_step < 1024` (memory-hive/config.json). Review K2-R2 (N3): a
# backfill of more steps -- every page costs one, ~170k facts -- ended at the
# edge without a word, started over at cursor "" the next night and died at
# the same place: `pending` forever, the delta never ran. The cell now stops
# one step short itself, parks where it stands in STATE_KEY, says so on
# stderr, and the next night resumes there.
STEP_LIMIT = 1024
# The night's own record, one `scratch` row: {"m": "done"} once a backfill
# finished, else where it stands ({"m": b1|b2|d|h, "c": cursor, "f": the
# window start of the night the backfill began}). Review K2-R2 (N1): the night
# chose the backfill by "no entity yet", and on every grown hive the first
# producer tick before the first night made one -- the old facts were never
# derived (one tick and two nights: 2 entities and 2 edges where the backfill
# over the same facts makes 7 and 14). `created_at` stays NULL: the scratch
# sweep of the dream lane deletes `created_at < cutoff`, and NULL never
# compares, so the record outlives the TTL that one run's parking rows have.
STATE_KEY = "entity-glue:graph"
# The longest run of words a tick looks up as one spelling. Review K2-R2
# (N5): a tick read every entity and every alias on each of its hops (300
# entities: 600 entity rows a tick). It now reads only the rows its facts can
# name; a spelling of more words than this is the night's (it derives every
# fact of its window again with every entity in hand).
MENTION_WORDS = 5
SPEAKER = re.compile(r"^peer [0-9a-z_-]+$")
# A name a claim spells but no stored entity carries yet ("Frieda Quastberg
# and Greta Grimmbach are each other's flatmates" names Greta before she is an
# entity): capitalised word runs, read as subject keys to LOOK UP -- a key no
# fact carries reads back nothing, so a wrong guess costs a row of `in`.
CAP_RUN = re.compile(r"(?:(?<=\s)|^)([A-ZÀ-Þ][\w'’-]+(?:\s+[A-ZÀ-Þ][\w'’-]+)+)")
# A word as the mention matcher sees it: letters and digits, joined inside by
# a dot, an apostrophe or a hyphen ("acme.example", "o'brien", "Jean-Luc").
TOKEN = re.compile(r"\w+(?:[.'’-]\w+)*")
POSSESSIVE = re.compile(r"['’]s$")
# What joins names in a subject ("Frieda Quastberg and Greta Grimmbach",
# "Mahler, Anna Alt", "Greta & Mahler"): such a subject is no name.
JOINER = re.compile(r"[,&]|\b(?:and|und|or|oder)\b")


def compound(k):
    """A subject that joins names is never an entity (coordinator ruling
    OR-K2-4): as one, its spelling is the longest match over both names and
    hides them. Its facts link the names it carries instead (`parts_of`)."""
    return bool(JOINER.search(k))

ENTITY_COLS = ["id", "subject_key", "canonical_name", "kind", "aliases", "valid_until",
               "merged_into", "valid_from"]
EDGE_COLS = ["id", "src_entity", "dst_entity", "edge_kind", "weight", "evidence",
             "relation", "relation_at", "episode_id", "channel", "audience_set", "valid_from",
             "valid_until"]
FACT_COLS = ["id", "episode_id", "subject", "canonical_subject", "claim", "source",
             "channel", "audience_set", "valid_from", "recorded_at", "closure_source",
             "expired_at"]


# ------------------------------------------------------------ the derivation

def norm(s):
    """The store's normal form of a subject: composed, lower-cased, one space."""
    return " ".join(unicodedata.normalize("NFC", str(s or "")).lower().split())


def spell_key(s):
    """A spelling as the matcher compares it: normal form, words joined by one space."""
    return " ".join(TOKEN.findall(norm(s)))


def alias_map(alias_rows):
    return {norm(r.get("alias")): norm(r.get("canonical"))
            for r in alias_rows if r.get("alias") and r.get("canonical")}


def resolve(key, amap):
    """Follow `subject_aliases` to the end of the chain; nothing else merges."""
    seen = set()
    while key in amap and key not in seen:
        seen.add(key)
        key = amap[key]
    return key


def alias_index(amap):
    """Every key -> the alias spellings that resolve to it."""
    out = {}
    for a in amap:
        out.setdefault(resolve(a, amap), set()).add(a)
    return out


def counts(f):
    """A fact that evidences: not forgotten, not retracted. A superseded fact
    still counts -- the relation it names was said, and the log is the record.
    close-glue writes a retraction as `close:<session>:retract` and a forget as
    `forget_request:<...>` (review finding 2: the first cut looked for a
    `retract` PREFIX, so every retracted fact kept evidencing)."""
    cs = str(f.get("closure_source") or "")
    return not (cs.startswith("forget") or cs == "retract" or cs.endswith(":retract"))


def fact_key(f, amap):
    return resolve(norm(f.get("canonical_subject") or f.get("subject")), amap)


def speaker_key(f, amap):
    src = str(f.get("source") or "").strip()
    return resolve(norm("peer " + src), amap) if src else ""


def fact_rank(f):
    """The order of evidence: newest statement last. Kept on the edge as
    `relation_at`, so a new fact replaces the relation without re-reading
    every older one."""
    return "|".join([str(f.get("valid_from") or ""), str(f.get("recorded_at") or ""),
                     str(f.get("id"))])


def entity_id(key):
    return "entity:" + hashlib.sha256(key.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:24]


def edge_id(src, dst, channel, audience):
    raw = "\x1e".join([src, dst, channel, audience])
    return "edge:" + hashlib.sha256(raw.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:24]


def name_windows(text):
    out = set()
    for m in CAP_RUN.finditer(str(text or "")):
        words = POSSESSIVE.sub("", m.group(1)).split()
        for i in range(len(words)):
            for j in range(i + 2, min(len(words), i + 3) + 1):
                out.add(norm(" ".join(words[i:j])))
    return out


def candidate(k, fs):
    if compound(k):
        return False
    live = [f for f in fs if counts(f)]
    if SPEAKER.match(k):
        return bool(live)
    return (len(live) >= MIN_FACTS
            and len({str(f.get("episode_id")) for f in live}) >= MIN_EPISODES)


def birth_at(k, fs):
    """The instant the subject first met the rule, from its facts alone -- so
    the producer, the night and the backfill stamp the same value."""
    live = sorted((f for f in fs if counts(f)),
                  key=lambda f: (str(f.get("recorded_at") or ""), str(f.get("id"))))
    eps = set()
    for i, f in enumerate(live):
        eps.add(str(f.get("episode_id")))
        if SPEAKER.match(k) or (i + 1 >= MIN_FACTS and len(eps) >= MIN_EPISODES):
            return str(f.get("recorded_at") or "")
    return ""


def canonical_name(k, fs):
    """The most frequent written spelling (ruling); a speaker reference is an
    address, not a name, so it never wins."""
    written = Counter(" ".join(str(f.get("subject") or "").split()) for f in fs if counts(f))
    plain = [(n, c) for n, c in written.items() if n and not SPEAKER.match(norm(n))]
    return sorted(plain, key=lambda x: (-x[1], x[0]))[0][0] if plain else k


def spellings(k, idx):
    """Coordinator ruling (OR-K2-2): an entity is mentioned only by its key and
    the alias rows that resolve to it -- no similarity, no stemming."""
    return sorted({k} | set(idx.get(k, ())))


def new_entity(k, fs, idx, kind="subject"):
    return {"id": entity_id(k), "subject_key": k, "canonical_name": canonical_name(k, fs),
            "kind": kind, "aliases": json.dumps(spellings(k, idx)),
            "valid_until": None, "merged_into": None, "valid_from": birth_at(k, fs)}


def proper(name):
    return str(name or "")[:1].isupper()


def entity_view(ent_rows, amap, births=()):
    """Live entities by key: neither closed nor merged away by an alias row."""
    view = {}
    for r in list(ent_rows) + list(births):
        k = norm(r.get("subject_key"))
        if not k or r.get("valid_until") or resolve(k, amap) != k:
            continue
        view[k] = {"kind": str(r.get("kind") or "subject"),
                   "proper": proper(r.get("canonical_name")), "row": r}
    return view


class Spellings(dict):
    """spelling -> (entity key, proper name?), and the widest spelling in words."""
    width = 1


def spell_table(view, idx):
    t = Spellings()
    for k in sorted(view):
        for s in spellings(k, idx):
            s = spell_key(s)
            if len(s) >= 3:
                t[s] = (k, view[k]["proper"])
    t.width = max([len(s.split()) for s in t] or [1])
    return t


def fact_windows(f, amap):
    """The name runs a fact spells: of its claim, and of a subject that joins names."""
    out = name_windows(f.get("claim"))
    if compound(fact_key(f, amap)):
        out |= name_windows(f.get("subject"))
    return out


def fact_masks(f, amap, present):
    """Spellings that are no entity but take their words in THIS fact, so a
    shorter entity spelling inside them is no mention (review finding 4,
    "Mahler" inside "Moritz Mahler"): the fact's own subject, and every name
    run of it that some stored fact carries as its subject (`present`, read
    from the store by key). Review K2-R2 (N4): the masks were the subjects
    that happened to be in hand -- a tick before the first "Moritz Mahler"
    fact wrote Anna-Mahler, the backfill (whose page held other subjects) did
    not, and no night repaired it. Only a spelling that is itself a name
    masks: a subject that joins names hides none of them."""
    ms = {norm(f.get("subject")), norm(f.get("canonical_subject")), fact_key(f, amap)}
    ms |= {w for w in fact_windows(f, amap) if resolve(w, amap) in present}
    out = set()
    for m in ms:
        s = spell_key(m)
        if m and not JOINER.search(m) and len(s) >= 3:
            out.add(s)
    return frozenset(out)


def _scan(text, table, longest, masks=frozenset()):
    raw = " ".join(unicodedata.normalize("NFC", str(text or "")).split())
    toks = [m.group(0) for m in TOKEN.finditer(raw)]
    low = [t.lower() for t in toks]
    width = max([getattr(table, "width", 1)] + [len(m.split()) for m in masks])
    found, i = set(), 0
    while i < len(toks):
        step = 1
        for n in range(min(width, len(toks) - i), 0, -1):
            g = " ".join(low[i:i + n])
            e = table.get(g)
            if e is None and g in masks:
                e = (None, False)
            if e is None:
                g2 = POSSESSIVE.sub("", g)
                if g2 != g:
                    e = table.get(g2)
                    if e is None and g2 in masks:
                        e = (None, False)
            if e is None:
                continue
            key, is_proper = e
            if not longest:
                if key:
                    found.add(key)
                continue
            # A proper name is a mention only when written with a capital:
            # "Rose" the neighbour, never "a rose" (review finding 4).
            if key and (not is_proper or toks[i][:1].isupper()):
                found.add(key)
            step = n
            break
        i += step
    return found


def mentions(text, table, masks=frozenset()):
    """Entity keys a claim names: whole words, the longest spelling wins."""
    return _scan(text, table, True, masks)


def mentions_any(text, table, masks=frozenset()):
    """Every entity spelling anywhere in the claim, nothing masked: the
    superset of what any earlier view could have derived."""
    return _scan(text, table, False)


def parts_of(f, view, table, amap, wide=False, present=()):
    ps = set()
    k = fact_key(f, amap)
    scan = mentions_any if wide else mentions
    masks = frozenset() if wide else fact_masks(f, amap, present)
    if k in view:
        ps.add(k)
    elif compound(k):
        # OR-K2-4: "Frieda and Greta Grimmbach share a flat" links the two --
        # by entity keys and alias spellings as whole words, as in a claim.
        ps |= scan(f.get("subject") or f.get("canonical_subject"), table, masks)
    ps |= scan(f.get("claim"), table, masks)
    sk = speaker_key(f, amap)
    if sk in view:
        ps.add(sk)
    return ps


def fact_edges(f, ps):
    ch, aud = str(f.get("channel") or ""), str(f.get("audience_set") or "")
    return {edge_id(a, b, ch, aud): (a, b, ch, aud)
            for a in sorted(ps) for b in sorted(ps) if a != b}


def _ev(row):
    try:
        v = json.loads((row or {}).get("evidence") or "[]")
    except Exception:
        v = []
    return {str(i) for i in v} if isinstance(v, list) else set()


def edge_target(old, shape, adds, removes, by_id, kind, at):
    """The row an edge should become. `adds` are fact dicts, `removes` ids.
    Returns (row or None, ids of evidence facts still needed to compute it)."""
    a, b, ch, aud = shape
    live = old is not None and not old.get("valid_until")
    before = _ev(old) if live else set()
    ev = (before - set(removes)) | {str(f["id"]) for f in adds}
    eid = edge_id(a, b, ch, aud)
    if not ev:
        if live:
            return dict(old, valid_until=at, evidence="[]", weight=0), []
        return None, []
    if live and ev == before and old.get("edge_kind") == kind:
        return None, []
    row = {"id": eid, "src_entity": a, "dst_entity": b, "edge_kind": kind, "weight": len(ev),
           "evidence": json.dumps(sorted(ev)), "channel": ch, "audience_set": aud,
           "valid_until": None}
    if live and not (before - ev):
        rel = {"relation": old.get("relation"), "relation_at": str(old.get("relation_at") or ""),
               "episode_id": old.get("episode_id"), "valid_from": old.get("valid_from")}
        for f in adds:
            if str(f["id"]) in before:
                continue
            if fact_rank(f) > rel["relation_at"]:
                rel.update(relation=str(f.get("claim") or ""), relation_at=fact_rank(f),
                           episode_id=f.get("episode_id"))
            vf = str(f.get("valid_from") or "")
            if vf and (not rel["valid_from"] or vf < str(rel["valid_from"])):
                rel["valid_from"] = vf
        row.update(rel)
        return row, []
    # Opened, re-opened, or evidence taken away: computed from every remaining
    # evidence fact (the night reads the ones it does not hold).
    missing = sorted(i for i in ev if i not in by_id)
    if missing:
        return None, missing
    fs = [by_id[i] for i in ev]
    top = max(fs, key=fact_rank)
    row.update(relation=str(top.get("claim") or ""), relation_at=fact_rank(top),
               episode_id=top.get("episode_id"),
               valid_from=min(str(f.get("valid_from") or "") for f in fs) or None)
    return row, []


def write_op(table, row, old, cols):
    if old is None:
        return {"operation": "insert", "table": table, "row": row}
    diff = {c: row.get(c) for c in cols if c != "id" and row.get(c) != old.get(c)}
    if not diff:
        return None
    return {"operation": "update", "table": table, "set": diff, "where": {"id": row["id"]}}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the reads

def leg(name, args):
    """A read named by what it asks: the planner sees from the reply alone
    which reads it already holds."""
    tag = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(args, sort_keys=True).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:10]
    return (name + "#" + tag, args)


def sel(table, where, cols, **kw):
    a = {"operation": "select", "table": table, "columns": cols, "where": where}
    a.update(kw)
    return a


def fts_phrase(s):
    return '"%s"' % " ".join(t.replace('"', "") for t in TOKEN.findall(norm(s)))


class Plan:
    """Reads are asked in stages; a stage whose read is not in the reply ends
    the hop with every read so far (the cell keeps no state between hops)."""

    def __init__(self, legs):
        self.legs = legs
        self.calls = []
        self.missing = False

    def get(self, name, args):
        cid, a = leg(name, args)
        self.calls.append((cid, a))
        if cid not in self.legs:
            self.missing = True
            return []
        p = self.legs.get(cid)
        return p if isinstance(p, list) else []


def ent_rows_all(pl):
    return pl.get("g-ent", sel("entities", {"subject_key": {"is_null": False}}, ENTITY_COLS))


def alias_rows(pl):
    return pl.get("g-alias", sel("subject_aliases", {}, ["alias", "canonical"]))


def count_keys(facts, view, amap, extra=()):
    keys = set(extra)
    for f in facts:
        k = fact_key(f, amap)
        if compound(k):
            # OR-K2-4: never counted itself; the names it carries are looked up
            # like the name runs of a claim.
            keys |= {resolve(n, amap) for n in name_windows(f.get("subject"))}
        else:
            keys.add(k)
        sk = speaker_key(f, amap)
        if sk:
            keys.add(sk)
        keys |= {resolve(n, amap) for n in name_windows(f.get("claim"))}
    return sorted(k for k in keys if k and k not in view)


def count_in(keys, idx):
    return sorted({s for k in keys for s in spellings(k, idx)})


def count_reads(pl, keys, idx):
    """One read per subject, so one large subject cannot crowd out the others."""
    out = []
    for k in keys:
        out += pl.get("g-count", sel("facts", {"canonical_subject": {"in": count_in([k], idx)}},
                                     FACT_COLS, limit=COUNT_PAGE))
    return out


def present_reads(pl, keys, idx):
    """The keys some stored fact carries as its subject: one read of one row
    per key, so a large subject cannot crowd out the others."""
    out = set()
    for k in sorted(keys):
        if pl.get("g-mask", sel("facts", {"canonical_subject": {"in": count_in([k], idx)}},
                                ["id", "canonical_subject"], limit=1)):
            out.add(k)
    return out


def text_spellings(text):
    """Every run of 1..MENTION_WORDS words of `text` as a store key could
    spell it: the words joined by one space (with and without a possessive),
    and the run as written, punctuation and all ("dr. mahler")."""
    raw = " ".join(unicodedata.normalize("NFC", str(text or "")).split())
    ms = list(TOKEN.finditer(raw))
    out = set()
    for i in range(len(ms)):
        for j in range(i, min(len(ms), i + MENTION_WORDS)):
            g = " ".join(m.group(0).lower() for m in ms[i:j + 1])
            out |= {g, POSSESSIVE.sub("", g), norm(raw[ms[i].start():ms[j].end()])}
    return out


def fact_spellings(f, amap=None):
    """Everything a fact can name: its subject, its speaker, the runs of its
    claim (and of a subject that joins names), its name windows."""
    amap = amap or {}
    out = {norm(f.get("subject")), norm(f.get("canonical_subject"))}
    src = str(f.get("source") or "").strip()
    if src:
        out.add(norm("peer " + src))
    out |= text_spellings(f.get("claim")) | name_windows(f.get("claim"))
    if compound(norm(f.get("canonical_subject") or f.get("subject"))):
        out |= text_spellings(f.get("subject")) | name_windows(f.get("subject"))
    return {s for s in out if s}


def resolve_reads(pl, cands, tag):
    """`subject_aliases` and `entities` for the spellings in hand -- never the
    whole tables (review K2-R2, N5). Alias chains are followed a few links."""
    cands = sorted(cands)
    if not cands:
        return [], []
    arows = list(pl.get(tag + "-af", sel("subject_aliases", {"alias": {"in": cands}},
                                         ["alias", "canonical"])))
    seen = set(cands)
    for _ in range(3):
        nxt = sorted(set(alias_map(arows).values()) - seen)
        if not nxt or pl.missing:
            break
        seen |= set(nxt)
        arows += pl.get(tag + "-ac", sel("subject_aliases", {"alias": {"in": nxt}},
                                         ["alias", "canonical"]))
    amap = alias_map(arows)
    keys = sorted({resolve(c, amap) for c in cands} | set(cands))
    arows += pl.get(tag + "-ar", sel("subject_aliases", {"canonical": {"in": keys}},
                                     ["alias", "canonical"]))
    erows = pl.get(tag + "-e", sel("entities", {"subject_key": {"in": keys}}, ENTITY_COLS))
    return arows, erows


def by_key(rows, amap):
    out = {}
    for f in rows:
        out.setdefault(fact_key(f, amap), {})[str(f.get("id"))] = f
    return {k: list(v.values()) for k, v in out.items()}


def births_from(keys, groups, stored, idx):
    """Entities the count makes: not stored at all (a closed row is the night's)."""
    out = {}
    for k in keys:
        fs = groups.get(k, [])
        if candidate(k, fs) and entity_id(k) not in stored:
            out[k] = new_entity(k, fs, idx)
    return out


# ------------------------------------------------------------ the producer

def produce(ids, legs):
    """One tick over the facts just written. Returns (plan, ops)."""
    pl = Plan(legs)
    new = [f for f in pl.get("g-new", sel("facts", {"id": {"in": ids}}, FACT_COLS))
           if f.get("id")]
    if pl.missing:
        return pl, None
    live = [f for f in new if counts(f)]
    if not live:
        return pl, []
    # Only the alias and entity rows these facts can name (review K2-R2, N5).
    cands = set()
    for f in live:
        cands |= fact_spellings(f)
    arows, erows = resolve_reads(pl, cands, "g-r1")
    if pl.missing:
        return pl, None
    amap, idx = alias_map(arows), alias_index(alias_map(arows))
    stored = {str(r.get("id")): r for r in erows}
    view = entity_view(erows, amap)
    keys = count_keys(live, view, amap)
    rows = count_reads(pl, keys, idx)
    if pl.missing:
        return pl, None
    groups = by_key(rows + new, amap)
    births = births_from(keys, groups, stored, idx)
    # The facts this tick derives: the new ones and every fact of a subject it
    # just made an entity (in hand from the count; mentions of a newborn in
    # OTHER subjects' older facts are the night's -- it searches for them).
    work = {str(f["id"]): f for f in live}
    for k in births:
        for f in groups.get(k, []):
            if counts(f):
                work[str(f["id"])] = f
    fresh = {str(f["id"]) for f in live}
    older = [f for i, f in sorted(work.items()) if i not in fresh]
    more = set()
    for f in older:
        more |= fact_spellings(f)
    more -= cands
    if more:
        arows2, erows2 = resolve_reads(pl, more, "g-r2")
        if pl.missing:
            return pl, None
        arows = arows + arows2
        erows = list({str(r.get("id")): r for r in list(erows) + list(erows2)}.values())
        amap, idx = alias_map(arows), alias_index(alias_map(arows))
    view = entity_view(erows, amap, births.values())
    # Masks from the store, by key (review K2-R2, N4): the counted keys are
    # known from the count, the name runs of the older facts are read.
    present = set(groups)
    unknown = {resolve(w, amap) for f in older for w in fact_windows(f, amap)}
    unknown = {k for k in unknown if k not in view and k not in keys and k not in present
               and not compound(k)}
    present |= present_reads(pl, unknown, idx)
    if pl.missing:
        return pl, None
    table = spell_table(view, idx)
    shapes, adds = {}, {}
    for f in work.values():
        for eid, shape in fact_edges(f, parts_of(f, view, table, amap,
                                                 present=present)).items():
            shapes[eid] = shape
            adds.setdefault(eid, []).append(f)
    erow = pl.get("g-edge", sel("entity_edges", {"id": {"in": sorted(shapes)}}, EDGE_COLS)) \
        if shapes else []
    if pl.missing:
        return pl, None
    old_edges = {str(r.get("id")): r for r in erow}
    ops = []
    for k, e in sorted(births.items()):
        ops.append(write_op("entities", e, None, ENTITY_COLS))
    for eid in sorted(shapes):
        old = old_edges.get(eid)
        if old is not None and old.get("valid_until"):
            continue  # review finding 3: never reopen what the night closed
        kind = "co-hub" if view[shapes[eid][1]]["kind"] == "hub" else "co"
        if old is not None:
            kind = old.get("edge_kind") or kind
        row, _ = edge_target(old, shapes[eid], adds[eid], (), work, kind, None)
        o = write_op("entity_edges", row, old, EDGE_COLS) if row else None
        if o:
            ops.append(o)
    return pl, ops


# --------------------------------------------------------------- the night

def night_from(log_rows, at):
    """The window start: the run this night closes, else the newest earlier one."""
    done = [r for r in log_rows if r.get("status") == "done"]
    mine = [r for r in done if str(r.get("delta_to") or "") == at]
    if mine:
        return str(mine[0].get("delta_from") or "")
    older = [str(r.get("delta_to") or "") for r in done if str(r.get("delta_to") or "") < at]
    # Review T2 (kf89 deep review): a quiet hive whose runs were all `skipped`
    # has no `done` run; the window then starts at the newest earlier run of
    # any status, never at the beginning of the whole history every night.
    anyrun = [str(r.get("delta_to") or "") for r in log_rows
              if str(r.get("delta_to") or "") and str(r.get("delta_to") or "") < at]
    return max(older, default="") or max(anyrun, default="")


def night_prev(log_rows, at):
    """Review N5 (kf89 deep review): the window start of the night BEFORE this
    one. A tick that read an edge before the night's write and wrote after it
    put a forgotten fact back into `evidence`; the next night saw that fact no
    more (its `expired_at` lay before the new window). The closed facts are
    therefore read from the previous night's start on: an overlap of one
    window, and removing a fact that is already gone writes nothing."""
    runs = sorted((str(r.get("delta_to") or ""), str(r.get("delta_from") or ""))
                  for r in log_rows if str(r.get("delta_to") or "") < at
                  and r.get("status") == "done")
    return runs[-1][1] if runs else ""


def window_page(where, after):
    """One page of the window's facts in id order, after the cursor `after`."""
    w = dict(where)
    if after:
        w["id"] = {"gt": after}
    return sel("facts", w, FACT_COLS, order_by=[{"col": "id"}], limit=BACKFILL_FACTS)


def night_delta(st, legs, at):
    """One page of the delta since `st["f"]`, derived to its end state.

    Review N6 (kf89 deep review): every write bundle of a night derived the
    WHOLE window again -- every fact recorded and closed since, their counts
    and their mention searches -- so a bulk day (a harness ingest, many
    sessions written at once) cost (edges / WRITE_OPS) full derivations. The
    window now goes a page at a time, like the backfill's pass 2: the facts
    recorded since and the facts closed since, each in id order after the
    cursor `st["c"]`, cut at the smaller last id of a full page so that no
    fact of either stream is skipped. A page is derived to its end state and
    written before the cursor moves; evidence is a set (`edge_target` adds and
    removes by fact id), so a fact a later page derives again (a mention of an
    entity born there) brings its edges to what one derivation of the whole
    window brings them to. Entities stored with a birth in the window before
    this night (a producer tick) have their mentions searched once, on the
    first page; an entity born on a page has them searched on that page.
    Returns (plan, ops, touched, cursor); the cursor is None on the last page."""
    since = st.get("f", "")
    after = str(st.get("c") or "")
    pl = Plan(legs)
    arows = alias_rows(pl)
    erows = ent_rows_all(pl)
    new = pl.get("g-new", window_page({"recorded_at": {"gt": since}}, after))
    closed = pl.get("g-closed", window_page(
        {"expired_at": {"gt": min(since, st.get("pf") or since)}}, after))
    if pl.missing:
        return pl, None, None, None
    full = [str(p[-1].get("id")) for p in (new, closed) if len(p) >= BACKFILL_FACTS]
    cursor = min(full) if full else None
    if cursor is not None:
        new = [f for f in new if str(f.get("id")) <= cursor]
        closed = [f for f in closed if str(f.get("id")) <= cursor]
    amap, idx = alias_map(arows), alias_index(alias_map(arows))
    stored = {str(r.get("id")): r for r in erows}
    by_k = {norm(r.get("subject_key")): r for r in erows}
    view0 = entity_view(erows, amap)
    merged = sorted(k for k, r in by_k.items()
                    if not r.get("valid_until") and resolve(k, amap) != k)
    base = {str(f["id"]): f for f in new + closed if f.get("id")}
    live_base = [f for f in base.values() if counts(f)]
    targets = {resolve(k, amap) for k in merged}
    keys = count_keys(live_base, view0, amap, extra=targets)
    rows = count_reads(pl, keys, idx)
    # Recount: a live entity (never a hub) whose facts were closed since.
    rec = sorted({fact_key(f, amap) for f in base.values() if not counts(f)}
                 & {k for k, v in view0.items() if v["kind"] != "hub"})
    recount = {k: pl.get("g-rc", sel("facts", {"canonical_subject": {"in": count_in([k], idx)}},
                                     FACT_COLS, limit=COUNT_PAGE)) for k in rec}
    if pl.missing:
        return pl, None, None, None
    groups = by_key(rows + live_base, amap)
    births, reopen = {}, {}
    for k in keys:
        fs = groups.get(k, [])
        if not candidate(k, fs):
            continue
        old = stored.get(entity_id(k))
        if old is None:
            births[k] = new_entity(k, fs, idx)
        elif old.get("valid_until"):
            reopen[k] = dict(new_entity(k, fs, idx), canonical_name=old.get("canonical_name"),
                             kind=old.get("kind") or "subject")
    gone = sorted(k for k in rec if not candidate(k, recount[k]))
    view = entity_view(erows, amap, list(births.values()) + list(reopen.values()))
    for k in gone:
        view.pop(k, None)
    dead = sorted(set(merged) | set(gone))
    medges = []
    if dead:
        medges = (pl.get("g-dead-src", sel("entity_edges", {"src_entity": {"in": dead},
                                                            "valid_until": {"is_null": True}},
                                           EDGE_COLS))
                  + pl.get("g-dead-dst", sel("entity_edges", {"dst_entity": {"in": dead},
                                                              "valid_until": {"is_null": True}},
                                             EDGE_COLS)))
    earlier = {k for k, v in view.items()
               if str(v["row"].get("valid_from") or "") > since} if not after else set()
    newborn = sorted(set(births) | set(reopen) | earlier)
    table = spell_table(view, idx)
    # A subject first stored in this window masks its words in OLDER facts
    # too (review K2-R2, N4: a tick before the first "Moritz Mahler" fact
    # wrote Anna-Mahler, and the window of that tick was gone by then). Only
    # a name of two words or more that carries an entity spelling can hide one.
    masked = sorted(k for k in {fact_key(f, amap) for f in live_base}
                    if k not in view and not compound(k) and len(spell_key(k).split()) >= 2
                    and groups.get(k)
                    and all(str(g.get("recorded_at") or "") > since for g in groups[k])
                    and mentions_any(k, table) - {k})
    hits, capped = [], []
    for k in newborn + masked:
        q = " OR ".join(fts_phrase(s) for s in spellings(k, idx) if spell_key(s))
        if q:
            got = pl.get("g-fts", {"operation": "search", "table": "facts", "match": q,
                                   "columns": FACT_COLS, "limit": NEWBORN_HITS})
            if len(got) >= NEWBORN_HITS:
                capped.append(k)
            hits += got
    mev = sorted({i for r in medges for i in _ev(r)} - set(base))
    if mev:
        hits += pl.get("g-mev", sel("facts", {"id": {"in": mev}}, FACT_COLS))
    if pl.missing:
        return pl, None, None, None
    work = dict(base)
    for f in hits + [f for k in births for f in groups.get(k, [])]:
        if f.get("id"):
            work[str(f["id"])] = f
    # Masks from the store, by key (N4): the counted keys are known from the
    # count, the name runs of the facts the night searched for are read.
    present = set(groups)
    unknown = {resolve(w, amap) for f in work.values() if counts(f) and str(f["id"]) not in base
               for w in fact_windows(f, amap)}
    unknown = {k for k in unknown if k not in view and k not in keys and k not in present
               and not compound(k)}
    present |= present_reads(pl, unknown, idx)
    if pl.missing:
        return pl, None, None, None
    shapes, adds, removes = {}, {}, {}
    touched = set(newborn)
    for f in work.values():
        narrow = fact_edges(f, parts_of(f, view, table, amap, present=present)) \
            if counts(f) else {}
        wide = fact_edges(f, parts_of(f, view, table, amap, wide=True))
        for eid, shape in narrow.items():
            shapes[eid] = shape
            adds.setdefault(eid, []).append(f)
            touched.update(shape[:2])
        for eid, shape in wide.items():
            if eid not in narrow:
                shapes[eid] = shape
                removes.setdefault(eid, set()).add(str(f["id"]))
                touched.update(shape[:2])
    for r in medges:
        shapes[str(r["id"])] = (r["src_entity"], r["dst_entity"], str(r.get("channel") or ""),
                                str(r.get("audience_set") or ""))
    erow = pl.get("g-edge", sel("entity_edges", {"id": {"in": sorted(shapes)}}, EDGE_COLS)) \
        if shapes else []
    if pl.missing:
        return pl, None, None, None
    old_edges = {str(r.get("id")): r for r in erow}
    plans, need = {}, set()
    for eid in sorted(shapes):
        a, b = shapes[eid][:2]
        old = old_edges.get(eid)
        if a in dead or b in dead:
            if old is not None and not old.get("valid_until"):
                plans[eid] = (dict(old, valid_until=at, evidence="[]", weight=0), old)
            continue
        kind = "co-hub" if view.get(b, {}).get("kind") == "hub" else "co"
        row, missing = edge_target(old, shapes[eid], adds.get(eid, []), removes.get(eid, ()),
                                   work, kind, at)
        need.update(missing)
        if row is not None:
            plans[eid] = (row, old)
    if need:
        extra = pl.get("g-evf", sel("facts", {"id": {"in": sorted(need)}}, FACT_COLS))
        if pl.missing:
            return pl, None, None, None
        for f in extra:
            work[str(f["id"])] = f
        for eid in sorted(shapes):
            if eid in plans or shapes[eid][0] in dead or shapes[eid][1] in dead:
                continue
            kind = "co-hub" if view.get(shapes[eid][1], {}).get("kind") == "hub" else "co"
            row, _ = edge_target(old_edges.get(eid), shapes[eid], adds.get(eid, []),
                                 removes.get(eid, ()), work, kind, at)
            if row is not None:
                plans[eid] = (row, old_edges.get(eid))
    # Review K2-R2 (N2): the night writes in bundles of WRITE_OPS and derives
    # the step again after each, and merged / gone / reopen are read off the
    # entity rows -- written first, they were gone from the next round, which
    # then left the edges of a merged entity open (WRITE_OPS 5: 18 of 20 open,
    # 1 of 20 re-hung edges written). So: the edges the step opens or changes
    # first, the edges it closes after them (a closed edge of a merged entity
    # is what the re-hung ones are read from), the entity rows last.
    ops, closing = [], []
    for eid in sorted(plans):
        row, old = plans[eid]
        o = write_op("entity_edges", row, old, EDGE_COLS)
        if o:
            (closing if row.get("valid_until") else ops).append(o)
    ops += closing
    for k, e in sorted(births.items()):
        ops.append(write_op("entities", e, None, ENTITY_COLS))
    for k, e in sorted(reopen.items()):
        ops.append(write_op("entities", e, stored.get(e["id"]), ENTITY_COLS))
    for k in merged:
        tgt = resolve(k, amap)
        r = by_k[k]
        ops.append(write_op("entities", dict(r, valid_until=at,
                                             merged_into=tgt if tgt in view else None), r,
                            ENTITY_COLS))
    for k in gone:
        r = by_k[k]
        ops.append(write_op("entities", dict(r, valid_until=at, merged_into=None), r,
                            ENTITY_COLS))
    for k, v in sorted(view.items()):
        if k in births or k in reopen:
            continue
        sp = json.dumps(spellings(k, idx))
        if v["row"].get("aliases") != sp:
            ops.append(write_op("entities", dict(v["row"], aliases=sp), v["row"], ENTITY_COLS))
    touched |= {resolve(k, amap) for k in merged} | set(dead)
    for k in capped:
        sys.stderr.write("entity-glue: mention search for %r came back full (newborn_hits %d); "
                         "a mention beyond it gets no edge from this night\n" % (k, NEWBORN_HITS))
    return pl, [o for o in ops if o], sorted(k for k in touched if k in view), cursor


def hub_step(legs, keys, at):
    """Degree of the touched entities -> `kind` hub/subject, and edges INTO a
    changed one re-kinded. Reads edges by src/dst (indexed), never facts."""
    pl = Plan(legs)
    erows = ent_rows_all(pl)
    arows = alias_rows(pl)
    if pl.missing:
        return pl, None
    amap = alias_map(arows)
    view = entity_view(erows, amap)
    keys = sorted(k for k in keys if k in view)
    if not keys:
        return pl, []
    deg = pl.get("g-deg", sel("entity_edges", {"src_entity": {"in": keys},
                                               "valid_until": {"is_null": True}},
                              ["id", "src_entity", "dst_entity"]))
    if pl.missing:
        return pl, None
    nbrs = {}
    for r in deg:
        nbrs.setdefault(norm(r.get("src_entity")), set()).add(norm(r.get("dst_entity")))
    want = {k: ("hub" if len(nbrs.get(k, ())) > HUB_DEGREE else "subject") for k in keys}
    changed = sorted(k for k in keys if view[k]["kind"] != want[k])
    if not changed:
        return pl, []
    into = pl.get("g-into", sel("entity_edges", {"dst_entity": {"in": changed},
                                                 "valid_until": {"is_null": True}},
                                ["id", "dst_entity", "edge_kind"]))
    if pl.missing:
        return pl, None
    ops = []
    for r in into:
        kind = "co-hub" if want.get(norm(r.get("dst_entity"))) == "hub" else "co"
        if r.get("edge_kind") != kind:
            ops.append({"operation": "update", "table": "entity_edges",
                        "set": {"edge_kind": kind}, "where": {"id": r["id"]}})
    # The entity's own kind goes LAST: it is what marks the step done, so a
    # step cut at WRITE_OPS comes back for the edges it has not re-kinded yet.
    for k in changed:
        r = view[k]["row"]
        ops.append(write_op("entities", dict(r, kind=want[k]), r, ENTITY_COLS))
    return pl, [o for o in ops if o]


def backfill_subjects(st, legs):
    """Backfill pass 1: subjects in key order, a page at a time -> entities."""
    pl = Plan(legs)
    arows = alias_rows(pl)
    erows = ent_rows_all(pl)
    page = pl.get("g-bf1", sel("facts", {"canonical_subject": {"gt": st.get("c", "")}},
                               FACT_COLS, order_by=[{"col": "canonical_subject"},
                                                    {"col": "id"}],
                               limit=BACKFILL_SUBJECTS))
    if pl.missing:
        return pl, None, None
    amap, idx = alias_map(arows), alias_index(alias_map(arows))
    stored = {str(r.get("id")): r for r in erows}
    if not page:
        return pl, [], None
    order = []
    for f in page:
        cs = str(f.get("canonical_subject") or "")
        if not order or order[-1] != cs:
            order.append(cs)
    # The last subject of a full page may continue on the next one -- unless it
    # is the only one (a page of one subject has more facts than any rule needs).
    done = order[:-1] if len(page) >= BACKFILL_SUBJECTS and len(order) > 1 else order
    cursor = done[-1]
    keep = set(done)
    groups = by_key([f for f in page if str(f.get("canonical_subject") or "") in keep], amap)
    ops = []
    for k in sorted(groups):
        if candidate(k, groups[k]) and entity_id(k) not in stored:
            ops.append(write_op("entities", new_entity(k, groups[k], idx, kind="pending"), None,
                                ENTITY_COLS))
    return pl, ops, cursor


def backfill_edges(st, legs):
    """Backfill pass 2: facts in id order, a page at a time -> edges (upsert by id)."""
    pl = Plan(legs)
    arows = alias_rows(pl)
    erows = ent_rows_all(pl)
    page = pl.get("g-bf2", sel("facts", {"id": {"gt": st.get("c", "")}}, FACT_COLS,
                               order_by=[{"col": "id"}], limit=BACKFILL_FACTS))
    if pl.missing:
        return pl, None, None
    if not page:
        return pl, [], None
    amap, idx = alias_map(arows), alias_index(alias_map(arows))
    view = entity_view(erows, amap)
    table = spell_table(view, idx)
    work = {str(f["id"]): f for f in page if counts(f)}
    # Masks from the store, by key -- never the subjects the page happens to
    # hold (review K2-R2, N4: page size 2 and page size 200 differed).
    present = {fact_key(f, amap) for f in page}
    unknown = {resolve(w, amap) for f in work.values() for w in fact_windows(f, amap)}
    present |= present_reads(pl, {k for k in unknown if k not in view and k not in present
                                  and not compound(k)}, idx)
    if pl.missing:
        return pl, None, None
    shapes, adds = {}, {}
    for f in work.values():
        for eid, shape in fact_edges(f, parts_of(f, view, table, amap,
                                                 present=present)).items():
            shapes[eid] = shape
            adds.setdefault(eid, []).append(f)
    erow = pl.get("g-edge", sel("entity_edges", {"id": {"in": sorted(shapes)}}, EDGE_COLS)) \
        if shapes else []
    if pl.missing:
        return pl, None, None
    old_edges = {str(r.get("id")): r for r in erow}
    ops = []
    for eid in sorted(shapes):
        old = old_edges.get(eid)
        # OR-K2-5: the kind comes from the kind the whole graph gave the target
        # (`hub_step` counts every edge), never from the page. Writing "co"
        # here flipped every edge into a settled hub when an interrupted
        # backfill ran again, and `hub_step` re-kinds only edges into an entity
        # whose own kind changes -- 95 `co-hub` -> `co` on the K2M snapshot.
        kind = "co-hub" if view[shapes[eid][1]]["kind"] == "hub" else "co"
        row, _ = edge_target(old, shapes[eid], adds[eid], (), work, kind, None)
        o = write_op("entity_edges", row, old, EDGE_COLS) if row else None
        if o:
            ops.append(o)
    return pl, ops, str(page[-1]["id"])


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the lanes

def store_bundle(calls, ph):
    """N store ops in one message, answered in one reply (#295)."""
    return {"header": {"route": "gstore", "phase": ph, "ent_clock": clock},
            "messages": [{"origin": "assistant", "type": "tool_call", "id": cid,
                          "text": json.dumps(args)} for cid, args in calls]}


def payloads_by_id(doc_):
    out = {}
    for m in doc_.get("messages") or []:
        if not isinstance(m, dict):
            continue
        try:
            payload = json.loads(m.get("text") or "")
        except Exception:
            payload = None
        out[str(m.get("id") or "")] = payload
    return out


def chunks(ops):
    return [ops[i:i + WRITE_OPS] for i in range(0, len(ops), WRITE_OPS)]


def phase_of(tag, st):
    return tag + "|" + json.dumps(st, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))


def park():
    sys.stdout.write(json.dumps([]))
    sys.exit(0)


def emit(msgs):
    sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(msgs))
    sys.exit(0)


def read_hop(pl, tag, st):
    """A read bundle; always two ops or more, so the store answers as a bundle."""
    calls = pl.calls
    if len(calls) < 2:
        # The night's own record: one row, read by its key (never a whole table).
        calls = calls + [leg("g-pad", sel("scratch", {"key": STATE_KEY}, ["key"]))]
    emit([store_bundle(calls, phase_of(tag, dict(st, k=st.get("k", 0) + 1)))])


def state_of(rows):
    """The night's record (STATE_KEY) as a dict; a finished one wins."""
    out = {}
    for r in rows or []:
        p = r.get("payload")
        if isinstance(p, str):
            try:
                p = json.loads(p)
            except Exception:
                p = None
        if isinstance(p, dict) and (not out or p.get("m") == "done"):
            out = p
    return out


def state_op(st, mode):
    """Write the night's record: where the backfill stands, or `done`."""
    body = {"m": mode, "at": clock}
    if mode != "done":
        body.update(c=str(st.get("c") or ""), f=str(st.get("f") or ""))
    payload = json.dumps(body, sort_keys=True)
    if st.get("sr"):
        return {"operation": "update", "table": "scratch", "set": {"payload": payload},
                "where": {"key": STATE_KEY}}
    return {"operation": "insert", "table": "scratch",
            "row": {"key": STATE_KEY, "kind": "entity-state", "payload": payload,
                    "created_at": None}}


def checkpoint(nst):
    """Record where the backfill stands, then go on with `nst` as a new step."""
    emit([store_bundle([("g-state-w", state_op(nst, nst["m"]))],
                       phase_of("ent-nw", dict(nst, sr=1, r=0, k=0)))])


def again(st):
    """The night goes on as a new step through its own counted round edge
    (`hop.ent_step`): the step restores the hop budget, which a backfill of
    many pages or a delta of many write bundles would otherwise run out of."""
    s = int(st.get("s", 0)) + 1
    nst = dict(st, s=s, k=0)
    if s >= STEP_LIMIT:
        # The round edge would drop this step without a word (N3).
        if nst.get("bf"):
            sys.stderr.write("entity-glue: backfill paused at step %d (%s, cursor %r); "
                             "the next night resumes it\n" % (s, nst.get("m"), nst.get("c", "")))
            emit([store_bundle([("g-state-w", state_op(nst, nst.get("m")))], "ent-paused")])
        sys.stderr.write("entity-glue: night step budget of %d spent in %s; the rest of "
                         "this window is left to the next one\n" % (STEP_LIMIT, nst.get("m")))
        park()
    emit([{"header": {"route": "entity", "phase": phase_of("ent-n", nst), "ent_clock": clock,
                      "ent_step": s},
           "messages": [{"origin": "assistant", "type": "text", "text": "{}"}]}])


if not globals().get("_ENTITY_LIB_ONLY"):
    def body_json():
        for m in d.get("messages") or []:
            try:
                v = json.loads(m.get("text") or "")
            except Exception:
                continue
            if isinstance(v, dict):
                return v
        return {}

    tag, _, raw = phase.partition("|")
    try:
        st = json.loads(raw) if raw else {}
    except Exception:
        st = {}
    legs = payloads_by_id(d) if op == "bundle" else {}
    # Review N8 (kf89 deep review): a store refusal arrives looking like an
    # answer (GH #343); read as one, it became an empty read and the tick or
    # the night derived from nothing (births again, edges with only the new
    # evidence). It is said and the hop ends; the next tick or night reads anew.
    # Review KF-F (F2): only a READ is parked. A refused night write (`ent-nw`
    # -- a `unique_violation` of a tick racing the night, a transient store
    # error) goes on as before: the next step derives anew from the store and
    # so heals it, and MAX_ROUNDS of rounds without progress end the step. A
    # parked night write ended the whole night, and no later night fetches the
    # rest of its window.
    if err and tag != "ent-nw":
        sys.stderr.write("entity-glue: store_error phase=%s operation=%s error=%s, hop parked\n"
                         % (tag, op, err))
        park()
    if err:
        sys.stderr.write("entity-glue: store_error phase=%s operation=%s error=%s, the night "
                         "derives anew\n" % (tag, op, err))

    if phase == "entity-new":
        ids = sorted({str(i) for i in (body_json().get("fact_ids") or []) if i})
        if not ids:
            park()
        tag, st, legs = "ent-p", {"ids": ids}, {}

    if tag == "ent-p":
        if st.get("k", 0) > MAX_ROUNDS:
            sys.stderr.write("entity-glue: producer gave up after %d hops\n" % st["k"])
            park()
        pl, ops = produce(st.get("ids") or [], legs)
        if ops is None:
            read_hop(pl, "ent-p", st)
        if not ops:
            park()
        # The producer's writes are independent of each other (one row each,
        # by id), so the chunks go out together and their replies park.
        emit([store_bundle([("g-w%d" % i, o) for i, o in enumerate(c)], "ent-written")
              for c in chunks(ops)])

    if tag == "ent-nw":
        # A night write came back: the next step starts with a fresh budget.
        again(st)

    if phase == "entity-night":
        tag, st, legs = "ent-n", {"m": "start", "s": 0}, {}

    if tag == "ent-n":
        mode = st.get("m")
        bf = bool(st.get("bf"))
        if st.get("k", 0) > MAX_ROUNDS or st.get("r", 0) > MAX_ROUNDS:
            sys.stderr.write("entity-glue: night step %s gave up (round %d, hop %d)\n"
                             % (mode, st.get("r", 0), st.get("k", 0)))
            if mode in ("d", "b1", "b2"):
                nxt = {"d": "h", "b1": "b2", "b2": "d"}[mode]
                again(dict(st, m=nxt, r=0, c="",
                           t=None if bf else (st.get("t", []) if mode == "d" else None)))
            park()

        def advance(**kw):
            nst = dict(st, r=0, k=0)
            nst.pop("n", None)
            nst.update(kw)
            return nst

        def written(ops, nst):
            # A round that wrote and still finds as much to write made no
            # progress (a refused write); MAX_ROUNDS of those end the step.
            stall = nst.get("r", 0) + 1 if len(ops) >= nst.get("n", len(ops) + 1) else 0
            emit([store_bundle([("g-w%d" % i, o) for i, o in enumerate(ops[:WRITE_OPS])],
                               phase_of("ent-nw", dict(nst, r=stall, n=len(ops), k=0)))])

        if mode == "start":
            pl = Plan(legs)
            logs = pl.get("g-log", sel("consolidation_log", {},
                                       ["run_id", "delta_from", "delta_to", "status"]))
            rec = pl.get("g-state", sel("scratch", {"key": STATE_KEY}, ["key", "kind", "payload"]))
            if pl.missing:
                read_hop(pl, "ent-n", st)
            sv = state_of(rec)
            have = 1 if rec else 0
            if sv.get("m") == "done":
                st, mode, legs = advance(m="d", f=night_from(logs, clock),
                                         pf=night_prev(logs, clock), sr=have), "d", {}
            elif sv.get("m") in ("b1", "b2", "d", "h"):
                # A backfill an earlier night began: on from where it stands,
                # and the delta of its whole span after it (`f`).
                mode = sv["m"]
                st, legs = advance(m=mode, c=str(sv.get("c") or ""), f=str(sv.get("f") or ""),
                                   bf=1, sr=have, t=None), {}
                bf = True
            else:
                # Never finished one (review K2-R2, N1: NOT "no entity yet" --
                # the first producer tick on a grown hive makes one). The
                # window start goes into the record first: the delta after
                # the backfill covers every tick and every forget since. A hive
                # that never dreamt has no earlier window: the backfill reads
                # every fact, and a delta from "" would read them all in ONE
                # select again (review finding 6) -- it starts at this night.
                checkpoint(advance(m="b1", c="", f=night_from(logs, clock) or clock, bf=1,
                                   sr=have))

        if mode == "d":
            pl, ops, touched, cursor = night_delta(st, legs, clock)
            if ops is None:
                read_hop(pl, "ent-n", st)
            # What a round touched is kept across its rounds and pages: the
            # last one writes nothing and sees no merge any more (N2).
            seen = sorted(set(st.get("t") or []) | set(touched or []))
            # Review N6: a page is written until nothing is left on it; the
            # cursor moves with its last bundle, and the last page is derived
            # once more after its writes, as the whole window was.
            if ops and (cursor is None or len(ops) > WRITE_OPS):
                written(ops, dict(st, t=seen))
            if cursor is not None:
                if ops:
                    written(ops, advance(c=cursor, t=seen))
                again(advance(c=cursor, t=seen))
            if bf:
                checkpoint(advance(m="h", t=None, c=""))
            st, mode, legs = advance(m="h", t=seen, c=""), "h", {}

        if mode == "b1":
            pl, ops, cursor = backfill_subjects(st, legs)
            if ops is None:
                read_hop(pl, "ent-n", st)
            if cursor is None:
                checkpoint(advance(m="b2", c=""))
            if len(ops) > WRITE_OPS:
                written(ops, st)
            if ops:
                written(ops, advance(c=cursor))
            again(advance(c=cursor))

        if mode == "b2":
            pl, ops, cursor = backfill_edges(st, legs)
            if ops is None:
                read_hop(pl, "ent-n", st)
            if cursor is None:
                # Every stored fact is derived: now the delta of the span the
                # backfill took (ticks, forgets, merges since it began).
                checkpoint(advance(m="d", c=""))
            # A page's writes are bounded by WRITE_OPS: the cursor moves on
            # only once the page has nothing left to write.
            if len(ops) > WRITE_OPS:
                written(ops, st)
            if ops:
                written(ops, advance(c=cursor))
            again(advance(c=cursor))

        if mode == "h":
            keys = st.get("t")
            if keys is None:
                # Backfill: every produced entity. A pending one is neither hub
                # nor subject, so the step settles every one of them.
                pl = Plan(legs)
                erows = ent_rows_all(pl)
                arows = alias_rows(pl)
                if pl.missing:
                    read_hop(pl, "ent-n", st)
                keys = sorted(entity_view(erows, alias_map(arows)))
            pl, ops = hub_step(legs, keys, clock)
            if ops is None:
                read_hop(pl, "ent-n", st)
            if ops:
                written(ops, st)
            if bf:
                # The last write of a backfill: the record says done, and
                # every night after this one is a delta.
                emit([store_bundle([("g-state-w", state_op(st, "done"))], "ent-done")])
            park()

    park()

min_facts.description: GH #1057: facts a subject needs (from at least `min_episodes` episodes) before it becomes an entity; a speaker reference is one regardless.

min_episodes.description: GH #1057: distinct episodes those facts must come from.

hub_degree.description: GH #1057: an entity with more distinct neighbours than this is a hub (`kind` `hub`, edges into it `co-hub`); recall's walk neither starts at nor enters one.

count_page.description: GH #1057: the rows one count read of a subject may return; a subject that is no entity yet becomes one at `min_facts`, so a full page means enough, and the canonical name is chosen from it.

newborn_hits.description: GH #1057: the facts one mention search of an entity born in the night's window may return; a full page is said on stderr, the mentions beyond it get no edge from that night.

ent_clock.description: GH #1057: the night's window end, carried through the store and back.

ent_step.description: GH #1057: the night's step counter on the counted round edge `./entity-glue -> ./entity-glue`, which restores the hop budget per step and stops at 1024.

description.purpose: GH #1057: the deterministic producer of `entities` and `entity_edges`, with no model call. After every fact write (`entity-new`, from the ingress) it reads the subjects the new facts touch and adds what they evidence; at the end of every dream run (`entity-night`) it derives the whole graph again and brings the stored rows to exactly that state. A candidate is a subject with at least two facts from at least two episodes, or a speaker reference; spellings resolve only through `subject_aliases`; the canonical name is the most frequent spelling; an edge joins two entities a fact names together (its subject, the entities its claim mentions, its speaker), one row per direction and per channel and audience, `relation` = the newest such claim, `weight` = the count, `evidence` = the fact ids.
description.use_when: Inside memory-hive only: the ingress and the dream glue reach it on route `entity`.
description.not_in_scope: No similarity merge, no model call, no delete: a pruned row gets `valid_until`, a merged entity also `merged_into`.
